read.en: Meta fell 1.2% on Nov 17 to $618.87, trading $613.51–627.48 on light volume (0.54x the 20-day average). It is below the 10-day ($626.7), 5-day ($627.9), 200-day ($629.9, falling), 100-day ($638.4) and 30-day ($661.2, falling). MACD has been above its signal since Nov 11, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 9 ($600.91), and RSI is 42.0.
read.zh: Meta 11月17日下跌 1.2%，收于 $618.87，盘中区间 $613.51–627.48，成交清淡（为 20 日均量的 0.54 倍）。股价位于 10 日（$626.7）、5 日（$627.9）、200 日（$629.9，下行）、100 日（$638.4）和 30 日均线（$661.2，下行）下方。MACD 自 11月11日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月9日起看多（$600.91），RSI 为 42.0。

read.en: The close slipped under the $618.9–620.1 support (Nov 12 and 16 lows), now resistance, after a $613.51 low. Resistance is $618.9–620.1, then $626.7–630 (10, 5 and 200-day, Nov 4 close) and $638.4–640.7 (100-day, Nov 16 high). Support is $613.5 (Nov 17 low), then $605.1–610.2 (Nov 5–6 closes) and $600.9 (SAR). A close above $620.1 would target $627–630; below $613.5, $605–610.
